parsed.name: GSIOC兼容实验室仪器
parsed.description: 这类设备是支持 GSIOC 串行通信协议的实验室仪器，通常通过 RS-422/485 总线连接，并可在同一总线上按单元地址进行选择与控制。它们常见于实验室自动化场景，用于样品处理、流体输送或其他需要串行联机控制的仪器系统。
parsed.description_en: This device class comprises laboratory instruments that support the GSIOC serial communication protocol, typically over an RS-422/485 bus. They can be addressed and controlled by unit ID on a shared serial bus and are commonly used in lab automation setups for sample handling, fluid transfer, or other instrument control tasks.

actions.description: 连接到串行总线上指定单元地址的 GSIOC 仪器。
actions.description_en: Connect to the GSIOC instrument with the specified unit ID on the serial bus.

actions.description: 以异步方式连接到串行总线上指定单元地址的 GSIOC 仪器。
actions.description_en: Asynchronously connect to the GSIOC instrument with the specified unit ID on the serial bus.

actions.description: 向 GSIOC 仪器发送即时查询命令并读取返回信息。
actions.description_en: Send an immediate query command to the GSIOC instrument and read back its response.

actions.description: 以异步方式向 GSIOC 仪器发送即时查询命令并读取返回信息。
actions.description_en: Asynchronously send an immediate query command to the GSIOC instrument and read back its response.

actions.description: 向 GSIOC 仪器发送缓冲指令命令以执行控制操作。
actions.description_en: Send a buffered instruction command to the GSIOC instrument to perform a control operation.

actions.description: 以异步方式向 GSIOC 仪器发送缓冲指令命令以执行控制操作。
actions.description_en: Asynchronously send a buffered instruction command to the GSIOC instrument to perform a control operation.
